headline: As of 2026-09-29: 514,883 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 23 of 50 states, D+44.2 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 514,883 early/mail ballots cast so far across 23 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+44.2 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (220,969), New Jersey (99,389), Wisconsin (51,538).
